title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.17339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hallucination detection for large language models is dominated by methods evaluated on 7B-70B research models with abundant sampling budgets and exact-match or ROUGE correctness labels. The small models practitioners actually ship on-device, Phi-3-mini, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-2B-Instruct, typically at 4-bit precision, sit outside this evidence base. We present a reproducible one-GPU audit of four detectors spanning three paradigms: length-normalized token-margin calibration, a lexical n-gram baseline, and two sampling-based consistency methods (semantic entropy and SelfCheckGPT-NLI) on two small open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) loaded at 4-bit NF4 quantization on a single Colab T4 GPU, evaluated on closed-book TriviaQA. Cross-model ranking transfer is poor: Spearman rho is -0.80 and Kendall tau-b is -0.667, meaning the detector ranking actively inverts between

translated_title: 排名还成立吗？面向从业者的小型量化端侧大语言模型幻觉检测器审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的幻觉检测方法目前主要在7B至70B规模的研究模型上进行评估，这些模型拥有充足的采样预算，并采用精确匹配或ROUGE等正确性标签。而从业者实际部署到设备端的小型模型——Phi-3-mini、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Gemma-2-2B-Instruct——通常以4位精度运行，却处于这一证据基础之外。我们对跨越三种范式的四种检测器进行了可复现的单GPU审计：长度归一化的token边际校准方法、词汇n-gram基线，以及两种基于采样的一致性方法（语义熵和SelfCheckGPT-NLI），在两个小型开源指令微调模型（Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct）上进行测试，模型以4位NF4量化方式加载在单个Colab T4 GPU上，并在闭卷式TriviaQA数据集上进行评估。结果显示跨模型的排名迁移性很差：Spearman ρ为-0.80，Kendall tau-b为-0.667，这意味着检测器的方法排名在两个模型之间会发生反转……
tldr: 本文通过单GPU可复现审计发现，幻觉检测方法在小型4位量化端侧模型之间的排名会发生反转，说明在大型研究模型上得出的检测器评估结论无法直接迁移到从业者实际部署的小型端侧模型上。
en_tdlr: A reproducible single-GPU audit shows that hallucination detector rankings invert across small, 4-bit quantized on-device LLMs, meaning conclusions drawn from large research models do not transfer to the compact models practitioners actually deploy.
